normative_action: Persistence model changes (Domain, configurations, DbContext) without a development seeder change produce a co-change reminder.
Persistence model changes without a migration produce a reminder to confirm whether the schema changed.
Changed migration files produce a reminder to review them as source code before committing.
Test projects or central versions using xUnit, MSTest or TUnit in addition to or instead of NUnit produce a warning.

Every instruction artifact carries the first-line header 'Kind | Scope | Capability | Loading' with a known Kind allowed at its location, a known Scope and a well-formed Capability; Level headers are not used; project-owned files only warn.
Rules live only in .claude/rules/<scope>/<topic>.md with the header Scope equal to the directory and non-empty paths frontmatter including the scope's canonical glob.
exceptions: Delivery rules declare their own globs.

normative_action: CLAUDE.md imports the decision register; imports must resolve and only OP/DEC artifacts may be imported; only CLAUDE.md contains @ imports.

Every skill directory has a SKILL.md whose frontmatter name equals the directory and which has a description (warning above 450 characters); no standalone serilog/resilience skills; template-maintenance is user-only; required workflows (WF) and knowledge skills (KNW) exist with the right Kind.
The code-reviewer agent must exist, disallow Write and Edit and delegate to the code-review workflow.
The agent body above 15 non-blank lines produces a warning: keep it a thin delegate.

Backtick references must resolve (unknown skills, unresolved or ambiguous references are errors); skill-private references are used only within their skill; non-routing references follow WF → KNW → STD → DEC → OP; a standard depends on another standard only when that scope loads reliably; the conformance graph is acyclic; pointers to dormant facet roles are allowed.
exceptions: Routing pointers (skills, agents, SKILL.md files) and enforcement pointers are not dependencies.

normative_action: Every ENF artifact declares 'Conforms:' (owners or —) on the line after its header; targets exist, have valid headers and are STD/DEC; capability facets conform only to neutral owners, their own module or the bound frame; every policy owner cited in the file must be declared.
The decision register carries slot-selection block markers with exactly one selection row per slot.

Slot contracts and module manifests declare '- Binds:'; only leaves bind and only to the architecture frame; required leaf → frame bindings must be present with a stated role or reason; a slot cannot bind itself.

Only the agreed slots exist; each has a contract with the right slot type and facet roles; a selection is recorded per slot; required slots cannot be none; at most one implementation is present and it must be the selected one with a module directory; a none selection has no implementation, knowledge facet or facet-role files; module binds match the contract; artifacts declaring a capability are listed facets of a selected module.

Module manifests exist with matching Capability, Slot, Implementation and Names; facet files exist with headers matching the manifest; the DEC facet is the register; non-knowledge facet file names are role-based; the module provides exactly the contract's facet roles (KNW = the register's knowledge facet); every contract item has a provider, and a 'missing' item requires a Decision Request before selection.

No artifact outside the module's facets and manifest, the map, the register's selection block and decision log and project-owned files names the selected implementation (its Names tokens); refer to the slot or facet role instead.
.claude/MAP.md exists, lists every artifact, lists no missing artifact and has a capability view per slot.

settings.json registers only PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure and Stop, each with matchers covering the required tools and exec-form command hooks (node + [${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/dispatch.cjs, event]) handled by the dispatcher, no variable expansion, a 1-600 s timeout; the PreToolUse policy hook fails closed and advisory hooks must not block on failure.
'normally' in OP/DEC/STD normative text produces a warning; use must/default/prefer.
An always-loaded surface above about 6000 tokens (CLAUDE.md, imports, model-invocable skill and agent descriptions) produces a warning; target about 5k.

Classify every instruction artifact by Capability (owned by the selected module of a replaceable slot, header 'Capability: <slot>/<implementation>', otherwise —), then Kind (OP, DEC, STD, KNW, WF, ENF, IN; decides mechanism and location), then Scope (decides rule directory and paths).

Dependencies point WF → KNW → STD → DEC → OP and ENF → STD/DEC, declared on each ENF artifact's Conforms line; product inputs never override policy; skill and agent references are routing pointers; changes to the system go through template-maintenance (user-invoked) and capability-selection changes through architecture-decision.
